name: media-hero
title: Media Hero
description: A cinematic media-first hero with a readable headline and optional image source.
author: iPolloWork

ai.instructions: Use a high-contrast image URL when available. Keep the headline under two lines and the supporting line concise.

variables.label: Title
variables.default: Put the story in the frame

variables.label: Supporting line
variables.default: One strong image. One unmistakable point.

variables.label: Semantic cue times
variables.description: JSON event IDs to measured scene-relative seconds. Empty uses authored timings; this is not word alignment.

events.action: Move gently within the actual image while preserving screen-fixed text
Settle on the evidence and hold

useWhen: Explore one supplied or sourced local image whose visible detail supports narration.
avoidWhen: Do not use a decorative pan for code or charts, fabricate factual imagery, or crop away critical evidence.

inputRules.title: Supply real title within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
inputRules.supporting: Supply real supporting line within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
inputRules.mediaUrl: Existing nonempty project-relative assets/ image; preserve provenance in the storyboard and identify illustrative imagery.
inputRules.label: Supply real label within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.

readingOrder: Inspect actual detail while text stays fixed

cueBindings.explore: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Move gently within the actual image while preserving screen-fixed text. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.
cueBindings.explain: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Reveal the supporting narration. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.
cueBindings.resolve: At the concluding narration clause, settle the shown evidence; allow the authored final reading hold.

fallback.overflow: Split at a real semantic boundary or use a more suitable component; never truncate items or shrink text until unreadable.
fallback.missingInput: Reuse or obtain a scoped authorized image; if unavailable use an honest editable diagram, not fake imagery.
fallback.timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once, preserving order, authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary when the sequence cannot fit; do not stretch speech or create a frozen tail.
fallback.inapplicable: Choose a component whose narrative job fits, or author a finite seek-safe custom scene. Recipe reuse is a default, not a requirement to force-fit content.

example.narration: 先观察仓库所在的空间，再讨论照明和入口。画面为示意插图，不是现场照片。

acceptance: Every active declared event changes its actual visible target; forward and backward seeking restore the same state.
The final state remains readable without cropped or overlapping important text, with honest source and timing metadata.
Orient in the image → Inspect actual detail while text stays fixed → Read the interpretation → Settle on the evidence. Preserve this reading order and the source qualifiers.
Test Chinese content, the minimum and maximum supported item counts, and one rejected overflow or malformed input.
